stories.title: Brits schaakwonder (11) behaalt als jongste speelster titel vrouwelijke grootmeester

en.title: British chess prodigy (11) achieves youngest female grandmaster title
en.summary: An 11-year-old British chess player has become the youngest person ever to achieve the female grandmaster title, securing the rank at a chess olympiad in Uzbekistan.

stories.title: Vlaamse jachtvereniging wil op everzwijnen jagen met pijl en boog

en.title: Flemish hunting association wants to hunt wild boar with bow and arrow
en.summary: A Flemish hunting interest group is seeking permission to hunt wild boar using bow and arrow, arguing this method would make hunting safer near residential areas.

stories.title: Partijleider Rassemblement National in het nauw door onthulling antisemitische chats

en.title: Rassemblement National party leader in difficulty over antisemitic chat revelation
en.summary: France's radical-right Rassemblement National party leader Jordan Bardella faces controversy after an investigation platform revealed antisemitic remarks he allegedly made in 2013 online messages, which he denies.

stories.title: Brits schaakwonder (11) behaalt als jongste ooit titel vrouwelijke grootmeester

en.title: British chess prodigy (11) achieves youngest ever female grandmaster title
en.summary: Eleven-year-old British chess player Bodhana Sivanandan has become the youngest person to ever achieve the female grandmaster title, earning it during the Chess Olympiad in Uzbekistan.

stories.title: Politie arresteert 24-jarige Amsterdammer in onderzoek naar hackerscollectief ShinyHunters

en.title: Police arrest 24-year-old Amsterdam resident in investigation into hacker collective ShinyHunters
en.summary: A 24-year-old from Amsterdam was arrested in connection with the ShinyHunters hacker collective, which claimed responsibility for a data theft at Odido.

stories.title: Starship-raket van SpaceX slaagt er voor het eerst in om baan om de aarde te bereiken, maar strandt wel voortijdig door kapotte motor

en.title: SpaceX's Starship rocket successfully reaches Earth orbit for the first time, but lands prematurely due to engine failure
en.summary: SpaceX's Starship rocket achieved orbit around Earth for the first time on Monday after fourteen previous attempts, though it terminated its flight early due to an engine malfunction.

stories.title: Amsterdammer aangehouden in onderzoek naar hackersgroep ShinyHunters

en.title: Amsterdam resident detained in investigation into hacker group ShinyHunters
en.summary: A 24-year-old man from Amsterdam was detained in connection with the ShinyHunters hacker group, known for attacking Odido and stealing data from millions of customers.

stories.title: Amsterdammer opgepakt in onderzoek naar hackerscollectief ShinyHunters

en.title: Amsterdam resident arrested in investigation into hacker collective ShinyHunters
en.summary: A 24-year-old man from Amsterdam was arrested for involvement with ShinyHunters, a hacker collective responsible for a major attack on Odido that resulted in the theft of millions of Dutch residents' personal data.

stories.title: Prominente Turkse komiek Deniz Göktas vrijgelaten, maar wel veroordeeld voor het beledigen van de president

en.title: Prominent Turkish comedian Deniz Göktas released but convicted of insulting the president
en.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktas was released after 88 days in pretrial detention. He was convicted for jokes made during his show but does not have to serve his prison sentence.

stories.title: Celstraf voor Turkse komiek die Erdogan 'verlegen dictator' noemde

en.title: Prison sentence for Turkish comedian who called Erdogan 'shy dictator'
en.summary: A Turkish stand-up comedian was sentenced to 19 months in prison for insulting President Erdogan and religious values in a performance. The comedian's show, posted online, garnered millions of views.

stories.title: Anderhalf jaar cel voor populaire Turkse komiek na beledigen Erdogan: ‘Een eer dat mijn woorden zoveel impact hebben’

en.title: 18 months imprisonment for popular Turkish comedian after insulting Erdogan: 'An honor that my words have such impact'
en.summary: A popular Turkish comedian has been sentenced to 18 months in prison for insulting President Erdogan during a performance.

stories.title: Turkse komiek veroordeeld voor beledigen Erdogan na 88 dagen voorarrest vrij

en.title: Turkish comedian convicted of insulting Erdogan released after 88 days in pretrial detention
en.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktas was convicted of insulting President Erdogan and religious values during a performance. He was released and does not have to serve his sentence.
